content: PyPA setuptools documentation states that files inside the package directory should be read-only, because installations are shared between users, may be mounted read-only, may be loaded from a zip, and may have several application instances running in parallel. Writing generated data there causes permission errors, upgrade and uninstall breakage, and cross-instance races. Recommended pattern: ship read-only templates read via importlib.resources and write runtime artifacts to a caller-supplied or platform user directory.
